ledger.title: Rough initial data and the strength of the blue-shift instability on cosmological black holes with Lambda > 0
ledger.evidence_excerpt: IOP abstract: '...by slightly relaxing the smoothness assumption on initial data, we are able to prove the analogue of the Christodoulou statement in the affirmative, i.e. we show that for generic data in our allowed class, the local energy blow-up statement indeed holds at the Cauchy horizon, for all subextremal black hole parameter ranges. ... This suggests thus that it is finally this class -- and not smoother data -- which may provide the correct setting to formulate the genericity condition in strong cosmic censorship.'
